pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
No. S. B. D. 136661
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 9, 1939

Subject National status of V. Krems.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Gaojov 30

According to information received from a
member of the former Czechoslovakian Consulate-General
in Shanghai, Valentin KREMS is the son of A.Krems, a
native of Sudeten district, who prior to the absorption
of Czechoslovakia by Germany, was registered here as
a Czechoslovakian citizen. It is reported that Mr.A.
Krems is married to a Russian and that their son does
not speak German.

From the same source it was learned that so
far there is nothing which could compel any citizen of
former Czechoslovakia here to take out German passport,
if he objects to the new state of affairs.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch )
pages.zh:
机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处
编号 S. B. D. 136661
特务科第一股
报告
日期：1939年10月9日

事由：V. Krems 的国籍身份。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由高乔夫（Gaojov）30 转呈

据从原驻上海捷克斯洛伐克总领事馆一名成员处获得的消息，瓦伦丁·克雷姆斯（Valentin KREMS）系 A. Krems 之子。A. Krems 为苏台德地区（Sudeten district）人，在德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克之前，已在此注册为捷克斯洛伐克公民。据悉，A. Krems 先生娶了一位俄罗斯女子为妻，其子不会讲德语。

从同一消息源还获悉，目前没有任何因素能迫使任何在此的前捷克斯洛伐克公民在反对新局面的情况下领取德国护照。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

副督察长（特务科）

pages.en:
CONFIDENTIAL

October 2nd, 1939.

Can it be verified that a Mr. VALentin
Plats, aged 19 years, whose parents are now
residing at 240 Avenue du Roi Albert, Shanghai,
is in fact a former Czechoslovakian subject?
He is now in Hongkong where he arrived on August
20th, 1939, in the S/S " St. Vincent de Paul"
and he was subsequently interned on the outbreak
of war as he holds German passport No: 86/39,
issued at the German Consulate, Shanghai, on
January 30th, 1939. He claims however that his
father was a Czechoslovakian subject and that he
only registered at the German Consulate in
accordance with orders issued after the absorption
of Czechoslovakia by Germany. Can it be established
that his name was registered at the former
Czechoslovakian Consulate in Shanghai?

D.S.J Robertson
C. 4/10.

"Y"

8/10
JR
pages.zh:
机密

1939年10月2日。

能否核实一位名为瓦伦丁·普拉茨（VALentin Plats）、现年19岁的男子确为前捷克斯洛伐克臣民？其父母现居住于上海阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）240号。他目前身处香港，于1939年8月20日乘“圣文森特·德·保罗”号轮船（S/S " St. Vincent de Paul"）抵达，并在战争爆发后因持有德国护照而被拘禁。该德国护照号码为 86/39，于1939年1月30日由德国驻上海领事馆签发。然而，他声称其父为捷克斯洛伐克臣民，自己仅是根据德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克后发布的命令在德国领事馆进行了登记。能否查明他的名字是否曾在原驻上海捷克斯洛伐克领事馆注册？

D.S.J 罗伯逊（Robertson）
C. 4/10.

“Y”

8/10
JR
